description: A serene, organic living room or entryway scene in warm sand and natural linen tones. The walls are finished in heavily textured artisan plaster in warm sand-beige with a rough, hand-applied quality reminiscent of Moroccan tadelakt or lime plaster. A long, low rustic console table in rough-hewn reclaimed pine or light oak with a lower shelf runs along the wall, its surface holding two medium terracotta pots with small potted olive trees and a small ceramic bowl in warm white. The lower shelf holds several softcover books stacked horizontally, a small woven seagrass basket, and a shallow ceramic bowl. To the left, a rounded, soft-form armchair upholstered in natural sand-linen fabric with tapered dark wood legs is partially visible with a gray wool throw draped loosely over one arm. The floor is covered by a large flat-woven natural jute or sisal area rug. The walls show no additional decorative objects. Warm ambient glow emanates from the wall above the console, creating a soft upward wash on the rough plaster texture. The overall color palette is monochromatic warm neutral — sand, linen, terracotta, natural jute — with small forest-green accents from the olive plants. The atmosphere is deeply serene and organic. Camera is at standing eye level, three-quarter corner composition looking at the console and left wall, normal lens.
